title: À la boulangerie
subtitle: At the bakery
review: Draft written by Claude. Check the text before recording audio.
intro: Buying bread: the most useful thirty seconds of French. Always open with bonjour.

lines.text: Voilà. Ça fait trois euros quarante.

tr.en: Here you are. That's three euros forty.
Here you go. Thank you, have a nice day!

notes: Vous désirez ? is shop French for 'What would you like?'. You will also hear Je vous écoute.
Et avec ceci ? means 'Anything else?'. To finish, say Ce sera tout, merci.
Merci à vous returns the thanks: 'No, thank YOU.'

questions.q: The baker asks « Et avec ceci ? ». What does she want to know?
questions.why: Et avec ceci ? = 'And with this?', the standard way to ask if you want something more.

questions.q: How do you say that you want nothing more?
questions.why: Ce sera tout, merci = 'That will be all, thank you.'

questions.q: What should you say first when you walk in?
questions.why: In France you greet before you ask. Skipping bonjour sounds rude.
